newsitem.title: USA: Berkley sees growth faster than industry.
newsitem.headline: Berkley sees growth faster than industry.

text.p: W.R. Berkley Corp, a property casualty insurance holding company, said Wednesday it expects to continue growing at a rate that is at least three times as fast as the industry while continuing to increase income.

William R. Berkley, chairman and chief executive officer, made the remark as the company reported that fourth quarter net income rose 53 percent to $21.976 million or $1.12 per common share from $14.381 million or $0.73 per share earned during the comparable 1995 period.
"We are very pleased with our progress and feel that the operating results of the company continue to reflect the investments we have made over the previous four years," he said.
At the same time, Berkley noted that the the insurance market remains very competitive, "and we continue to see our competitors engaging in what appears to be irrational pricing."
He said this produces "a difficult operating environment in the short run," but such competitors will pay for this in the long run with low returns and weakened balance sheets.
"We shall continue to seek and seize opportunities, price our products responsibly and work diligently to ensure that we meet the needs of our agents and insureds," he said.
Berkley is a holding company which, through its subsidiaries, does business in all segments of the property casualty insurance business.
